title: Tenseigan Chakra Mode
body:
Syntax: perform tenseigan chakra mode [on|off]

Minimum level 100, Byakugan mastery 100% and inherited Potential 100 or higher. This toggles Byakugan or a short-lived defensive/celestial form. Higher modes have higher chakra upkeep. See 'help hyuga' for full bloodline rules. A technique only becomes available when level, mastery, and the character's permanent bloodline potential all qualify.
